text: The report requests that the City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one City-owned tree located at 303 Delta Street. The application indicates the reason for removal is to accommodate the widening of the driveway within the City-owned right-of-way resulting from recent Committee of Adjustment approvals to construct a new detached dwelling with an attached garage. The subject tree is a hedge maple (Acer campestre), measuring 33 cm in diameter. The Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on July 28 and 29, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one City-owned tree located at 303 Delta Street.
